concept: AI generates a whimsical Chindogu-style 'un-useless' invention concept for a described everyday annoyance, in the spirit of Kenji Kawakami's Chindogu principles, explaining why a genuine Chindogu must remain almost, but not quite, entirely useless.

Describe a found stone's shape and where you found it, and AI matches it to a suiseki viewing-stone classification (distant mountain, waterfall, island, hut) and explains traditional display (daiza stand or suiban tray) and viewing etiquette.

AI matches a described shrine visit (deity type, occasion, region) to real torii gate styles (Shinmei, Myojin, Kasuga, Inari senbon-torii) and explains their structural differences and the meaning of passing through off-center.

AI matches household size and region to a traditional New Year kadomatsu arrangement (bamboo cut style, pine, ume), explaining regional variations and correct display and removal dates (matsu-no-uchi).
